basics.name: Cynthia Chen
basics.summary: Cognitive Scientist interested in using computational models to understand how intelligence emerges from the basic building blocks of neurobiology

work.name: Allen Institute for Data Driven Discovery in Biology
highlights: Designed neural network architecture incorporating reinforcement learning for decision making under uncertainty, outperforming baseline models.
Used cloud computing and GPU acceleration to train deep learning models on large datasets.
Presented emergence of interpretable value representations at AAAI conference.
Designed Markov models to represent state-mediated decision-making and belief-update processes in rodent experiments.
Applied regression and likelihood estimation to model strategies predicting experimental data.

work.name: NeuroCognition Lab
highlights: Applied EEG data processing using Fourier transforms and ICA in EEGLab.
Designed CNN and Transformer models for EEG decoding in BCI applications, achieving competitive classification accuracy.
Presented research to REU cohort and authored symposium paper detailing methods and results.

work.name: Social Entrepreneurship, Networks, Digital Innovation Lab
highlights: Awarded Aresty Summer Science grant and presented at Symposium.
Conducted exploratory analysis and literature review for ICA conference abstract.
Analyzed and coded 50+ papers and interview transcripts about nonprofit resilience and stakeholder management.
Evaluated BERTopic classifications of Twitter data on climate change and mental health.
Facilitated interactive booth teaching visitors aged 5–15 about EMG signals and related technologies.
Designed graphics to promote weekly events.
Supported marketing team to ensure accurate event representation.
Collaborated with executive board and external organizations to plan weekly events.
Created interactive presentations on cognitive science topics.
Contributed to peer review of three interdisciplinary undergraduate research papers.
Collaborated with editorial committee on paper selection and curation.

publications.name: Information Based Value Iteration Netowrks for Decision Making Under Uncertainty
publications.summary: In this paper, we show how Value Iteration with Value of Information Networks can take advantage solve problems with varying levels of uncertainty by reducing the belief space
